type.description: Discriminator: the listed entry is a document.

path.description: Path segments of the document within its account; empty for the home document.

authors.description: Uids of every account that has modified the document, including the original author.

updateTime.description: Time the document was last updated.

genesis.description: CID of the document's genesis change.

breadcrumbs.description: Ancestor documents along the path, resolved to display names.

activitySummary.description: Latest comment and change activity on the document.

genesis.description: CID of the genesis change the generation starts from.

generation.description: Opaque generation number; a higher generation supersedes earlier ones for the same genesis.

generationInfo.description: Generation of the document that this listing entry reflects.

redirectInfo.description: Present when the document is a redirect or republish of another document.

metadata.description: The document's metadata, such as name, icon, and cover.

firstImageInContent.description: Link of the first image block in reading order; empty string when the document has no image, absent when not derived yet.

visibility.description: Visibility, `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`; unset or unspecified values read as `PUBLIC`.

description: One document in a listing: identity, authorship, timestamps, breadcrumbs, and activity summary, without content.
